findings.problem: The guide says 'at 60+ columns all three fit'. At 60 columns the body is 51; family_caps is 55 and paid.continue 54, so both clip. family_caps needs 64 columns and paid.continue 63; only eligibility_unknown (37) fits at 60. The same paragraph already states paid.continue needs 63, so the threshold sentence contradicts its own numbers. The accepted disposition (keep relay wording, accept clipping) is otherwise recorded and stands.
findings.suggestion: Replace 'at 60+ columns all three fit' with 'at 64+ columns all three fit; in the 60-63 band family_caps and paid.continue still clip'. Keep the exception itself.
findings.evidence: probe D1/SG-1; rich.cells.cell_len; usage_panel.py geometry (panel = columns - 4, content = panel - 4, body = content - 1)

findings.problem: The guide says es 35 against en 23. es 35 is correct; en 'Spend eligibility unknown' measures 25 with both rich.cells.cell_len and len. The exception still stands (35 > 25), but the comparator is understated by two cells.

findings.key: i18n/style-guides/es.md — tui.usage paid annotation exception rationale
findings.problem: The guide says both strings are byte-identical to the shipped relay.shell.usage family. eligibility_unknown is identical; family_caps is not: relay is 'Siguen aplicándose los límites por familia de modelos.' and TUI is 'siguen aplicándose los límites por familia de modelos' (initial capital and final period differ).
